question: What share of the world's uranium came from one mine, McArthur River?
answer: For many years, McArthur River in Saskatchewan, Canada, produced about 15% of the world's uranium on its own. That is roughly 3 kilos in every 20 mined anywhere on Earth.
move: Uranium supply is concentrated: one Canadian mine once made 15% of it.
